title: Why Black Maternal Deaths Stayed at 50.3 as Others Fell
hook: Black maternal deaths stayed at 50.3 while the national rate fell.
closing: A falling national average can hide who is still being left behind.
question: Did that gap surprise you?

segments.say: The national maternal death rate fell to 18.6, dropping below its pre-pandemic level.
Black maternal deaths stayed at 50.3, so the national recovery did not reach everyone.
White women were at 14.5, revealing how much higher the risk remained for Black mothers.
